headline: Start next year's gift fund now
lede: Give every goal its own bar, from holiday gifts to an emergency fund.
caption: Track every goal. Save with purpose.

pin.title: Savings Goals Tracker Spreadsheet for Sinking Funds
pin.description: Set up a fund for next year's holiday gifts next to your emergency fund, trips and other goals. Each fund gets a target, a progress bar and the amount still needed, and every deposit you log updates it. Works in Google Sheets and Excel.
pin.alt: Dark savings goals tracker spreadsheet on a laptop with total saved, still needed and a progress bar for each fund, under the headline Start next year's gift fund now.
